package.name: jupiter_safety
package.description:
Tier 2 safety layer for Jupiter rover.
Provides perception-independent stuck detection and forced recovery, bypassing nav2's collision-check-based recovery limitations.
Components: - stuck_detector: monitors cmd_vel vs MCU encoder feedback (motor stall) and IMU acceleration spikes (collision). Publishes /stuck_status. - forced_recovery: on stuck, directly publishes backward cmd_vel to /cmd_vel_force with rear-LiDAR safety check. Bypasses nav2 collision checks. - alert_publisher: drives OLED / buzzer alert when stuck. - twist_mux config: prioritized cmd_vel multiplexing (joy > force > nav).
